description: Designing and developing AI-powered full-stack applications using Python (Django), LangChain, REST APIs, and modern React-based front-end frameworks.
Building scalable features integrating LLM workflows, data processing pipelines, and responsive user interfaces focused on delivering impactful and human-centered AI solutions.
Collaborating with cross-functional remote teams across multiple time zones, contributing to architecture decisions, research initiatives, and product development.
Developed and maintained full-stack features for production web applications.
Collaborated with the engineering team on feature planning and implementation.

Worked on developing tasks, and small projects for international clients using React.js, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and MySQL. I implemented my knowledge and the technologies that I have learned so far.

I worked for Prodexo, a company that provides services in web development, server management, and content management. I was responsible for developing the back end for the Opomise application, a French start-up that helps people to sponsor their businesses efficiently and more easily.

The main tasks that I was responsible for were:
 Developing application Back-end using Laravel 9.
 Working with Facebook APIs and Facebook SDK for PHP.
 Designing and developing Databases using MySQL with Eloquent.
 Providing the user with the ability to create Ads and sponsor his or her business pages.
